title: Python SDK: telemetry-driven streaming retry floorplan and ergonomic event adapter
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a telemetry-driven retry policy and a lightweight ergonomic adapter for streaming chat completions in the Python SDK. The goal is to reduce developer friction when handling incremental events (token / delta / tool calls), surface clear retry semantics driven by observed telemetry signals (latency, partial-output rate, duplicate fragments), and provide examples that show best practices for backpressure and idempotent consumers.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable Python 'TelemetryRetryPolicy' class that consumes SDK telemetry hooks and decides soft/hard retry points as a policy (configurable thresholds)
A minimal 'EventAdapter' abstraction that normalizes raw streaming events into a typed generator interface and exposes explicit watermark checkpoints for safe resume
Three example cookbooks: (1) resumable chat consumer with checkpointing, (2) fanout to sideband processors with idempotency keys, (3) bounded backpressure consumer using asyncio queues
Unit tests covering retry triggers for latency spikes, partial-fragment loss, and service-initiated reconnects
Integration smoke test validating that telemetry-driven retries reduce observed error rates for a synthetic noisy network by >= 40% in the test harness
tasks: Write design doc: telemetry signals, thresholds, API surface, and default configs
Prototype EventAdapter API and small shim for existing stream consumer examples
Implement TelemetryRetryPolicy and integrate with SDK event dispatcher
Add telemetry hooks (latency, fragment_gap_ms, duplicate_fragment_count) to streaming runtime
Author three example notebooks and unit/integration tests
Create CHANGELOG entry and migration notes for existing consumers
progress_updates: 2026-02-19 - Kickoff: scoped feature to telemetry-driven soft/hard retries and an ergonomic adapter instead of broad refactor. Decided to keep adapter lightweight to avoid coupling with application logic. (Aisha)
2026-02-25 - Draft design doc uploaded to Confluence. Chosen signals: downstream_ack_latency, fragment_gap_ms, consecutive_fragment_errors. Default thresholds proposed but configurable. (Liam)

2026-03-03 - Prototype EventAdapter implemented; normalizes events into classes: TokenDelta, FunctionCall, Done, Keepalive. Basic generator semantics returning typed events. Integration tests passing locally. (Liam)

2026-03-10 - TelemetryRetryPolicy added and wired to stream dispatcher. Policy supports exponential backoff for soft retries and immediate failover to fallback model for hard failures. Added feature flag for rollout. (Aisha)
2026-03-12 - Started authoring example cookbooks; first cookbook (resumable consumer) ready for review. (Liam)
decisions: Keep EventAdapter as an opt-in utility rather than automatic transformation to avoid breaking existing consumers
Expose telemetry signals as high-level named metrics in SDK (strings) rather than raw numeric tuple to simplify policy authorship
Use generator-based consumer API (yield typed events) for ergonomic async/await integration and easier composition with existing examples
